01 — WHAT'S INSIDE

Four systems, one illusion

The space spans a bedroom and a study. Each system is built to behave like a life in progress rather than a menu of things to click.

24H · LIVE CLOCK

Real-time Schedule实时日程

He keeps his own 24-hour day. Your real-world clock decides where you find him and what he's doing — reading in the study, or already asleep in the bedroom.

  • Entry time maps to location (study / bedroom) and state (awake / asleep).
  • You can invite him from the study to the bedroom — and he may decline.
23:00 · ASLEEP

Sleep Companion睡眠陪伴

Late at night he lies down and, left alone, drifts off on his own. Poke him and he might stir — or might not answer at all.

  • Probabilistic wake response: presence, not a guaranteed reaction.
  • Music auto-ducks the moment he sleeps, and returns when he wakes.
AMBIENT · DAY ⇄ NIGHT

Living Environment环境交互层

Day and night swap the full art set. The room sounds like the hour it actually is, and small controls give him room to react.

  • Time-driven ambience: birdsong by day, insects after dark, rain at random.
  • Toggle lights or the window — a chance each time of a character-specific response.
WHISPER · PAID

Narrative & Whisper短剧情 · 私语

Touch, tap and talk draw from different short-scene libraries, unlocked through the main card-progression system. Whisper is the paid layer on top.

  • Companion scenes gate behind main-story card growth — intimacy is earned.
  • Whisper: long-form audio you start and then do nothing in — built for the minutes before sleep.
02 — WHY IT WORKS

Four decisions that buy belief

Realism isn't fidelity of art — it's behavior the player can't fully command. These are the calls that did the heavy lifting.

i.

Presence before interaction

He isn't summoned. Open the space and he's already living in it — existence comes first, interaction is something you choose to add. 存在感先于互动 — 他本来就在，不需要被激活。

ii.

He's allowed to say no

An invitation can be refused. A small chance of “not right now” does more for believability than any amount of polish — real people aren't always available. 男主有权拒绝 — 拟真感最直接的体现。

iii.

Progression earns intimacy

Companion content is gated by the main card-growth loop, so the relationship deepens as the player invests rather than unlocking all at once. 养成联动解锁 — 卡牌养成与陪伴场景打通。

iv.

Whisper asks nothing of you

No prompts, no choices, no taps. Removing every interaction cue is what dissolves the line between playing a game and lying next to someone. 私语零反馈 — 消除“在玩游戏”与“和一个人在一起”的隔阂。

03 — SEEN IN GAME

The same clock, three states

What the player meets is decided before they touch anything — by the time of day they happened to open the space.

DAYAwake · Reading Open the space while he's scheduled awake and you find him mid-book — not posed for you, just occupied.
00:00:21Night · Drifting off Late and undisturbed, he lies down and falls asleep on his own; the music quietly steps back with him.
00:02:58Whisper · Paid The Whisper menu — night murmurs, pillow talk and more: long audio scenes the player starts, then simply listens to.
04 — WHAT PLAYERS SAID

It changed how long they stayed

Unprompted player reviews from RED (Xiaohongshu), translated. The retention shift is the part a Live Ops team cares about most.

Once the sleep-into-the-bedroom feature shipped, I spend so much longer in Aurora every day. I used to just collect my stamina and leave.

— Player, RED · 小红书

Whisper is one of Aurora's greatest inventions. Drifting off to your partner's even breathing, right after a moment of closeness at bedtime — nothing makes me happier.

Player · RED

Every character sleeps differently — pillow height, posture, whether he turns to watch you. Someone clearly thought hard about these details.

Player · RED

When he falls asleep the music quietly drops, then comes back when he wakes. I never expected a game to care about that.

Player · RED

I love the bedtime whispers — headphones on, lights off. If I weren't worried about my phone overheating I'd leave it running all night.

Player · RED

The read for Live Ops: a screen players used to treat as a daily-resource pit stop became somewhere they choose to linger — and the paid Whisper layer turned that lingering into a willingness to spend.

1,390 ♡   60 💬 · NAMI's post · 2025-08-27
（评论）特别喜欢这个卧室，晚上到点他们就会去休息了，特别真实，有事忙就出门，没事忙就在家里，到点累了就上床，困了就睡觉——他们也在好好生活。
"Really love this bedroom — they go to rest when it's time, at night. It feels so real. Busy, they go out; nothing to do, they stay home. Tired, they go to bed. Sleepy, they sleep. They're just living their lives."
— comment by 未来, 60 ♡
A player describing the 24-hour schedule system without naming any mechanic — they experienced it as behaviour, not a feature. "They're just living their lives" is the design goal, written back to us by a player.
1,390 ♡   60 💬 · same post, author reply
熬到半夜两三点偷摸进屋，要是他们还没睡，莫名有种被抓包的感觉。
"Sneaking in at 2–3am — if they're still awake, you get this inexplicable feeling of being caught."
— NAMI (author)
The real-time clock made entering the space feel like entering someone's actual home — to the point where arriving late felt like trespassing. This is presence design working exactly as intended.
61 ♡   8 💬 · 薔薇's post
正常情况下去暇光邀请他们有时会被拒绝去卧室——柏源和萧因拒绝过，萧因第二次答应了，小遇会反过来邀请我们，但让他换睡衣他说明天换……每个人的枕头高度和睡姿都不同。
"Inviting them to the bedroom can be refused — 柏源 and 萧因 have turned me down; 萧因 accepted the second time; 小遇 even counter-invites. Each character has a different pillow height and sleep posture."
A player who tracked the refusal logic across multiple sessions and documented it publicly — not to complain, but to analyse. Low engagement, high signal: this player engaged with the system deeply enough to map it.
359 ♡   41 💬 · 不羡羽's post
世界之外最伟大的发明之一，我必须提名私语……谁懂睡前来这么一段耳鬓厮磨后再听着爱人均匀的呼吸入睡有多快乐……今晚我必早早躺好，大听特听！！！
"One of World Beyond's greatest inventions — I have to nominate Whisper. Drifting off to your partner's even breathing after a moment of closeness at bedtime. Tonight I'm getting to bed early to really listen!!"
The player calls it an "invention" — not a feature, not content. And the post ends with a behavioural intention: going to bed earlier to use it. That is the Whisper design goal: changing a player's real-world bedtime routine.

Every choice in Aurora Bedroom answers the same question:
does this make him feel more like a person, or more like a button?

What I'd bring to a Live Ops team — a habit of designing the loop and the feeling together, and treating restraint as a feature when the goal is attachment rather than activity.
